title: [3.0-beta6] NSClient Crash on startup
body:
NSClient 3.0-beta6
BuildVersion: ae52998d2-2021.11.16-21:20
Flavor: nsclient-debug/release
Nightscout version: 14.2.4
Engineering mode enabled
Device: Xiaomi MI 9, Android 11, MIUI 12.5.1

NSClient crashes on startup, a few seconds after logo shows up.

PlayProtect is Off.
Tried Uninstall, reinstall, force stop, clear data (android settings), delete AAPS folder, delete project folder, build from different pc.

Same crash with NSClient dev built 15.11, on Galaxy A10s SM-A107F, Android 11

NSClient 3.0-beta5 works on both phones.

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7549784/AndroidAPS.log)

[AndroidAPS1.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7549907/AndroidAPS1.log)

comments.body: I have exactly the same experience...NSClient (3.0-beta6) crash on startup...I have Galaxy Note10+. All others 3.0 Beta versions without Problems. The same problem on my wifes Galaxy S21.

I can't now upload log, then when the App not starts,  she have's not the logs directory and I can't go to the App and Send Logs per Email. But the Master AAPS 3.0 Beta6 goes on both Phones without Problems...
If you give storage permission via android settings, you will have the log.

Yes, this have I not tried...THX

Here is the LOG file.

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7554068/AndroidAPS.log)
